INT. CL. 9 Data processing equipment, data storage apparatus namely, data processors for scanning, reading, storing and interpreting
electronic data contained on radio frequency identification (RFID) and near field communication (NFC) chips; microprocessors;
interfaces for computers; integrated circuits (ICs), integrated circuit chips; semiconductors; smart cards, namely, blank smart
cards; encoded smart cards containing programming used for public transit, payments, loyalty programs, hospitality,
transportation, student identification cards, identification cards, membership cards, parking, event management, vehicle sharing,
and access management, namely, access to certain areas, gaining access to buildings, gaining access to premises, and gaining
access to vehicles; smart card integrated circuits, namely, blank integrated circuit cards; encoded integrated circuit cards
containing programming used for public transit, payments, loyalty programs, hospitality, transportation, student identification
cards, identification cards, membership cards, parking, event management, vehicle sharing, and access management, namely,
access to certain areas, gaining access to buildings, gaining access to premises, and gaining access to vehicles; radio frequency
identification (RFID) labels; radio frequency identification (RFID) tags; blank smart cards with integrated radio frequency
identification (RFID) chips; encoded smart cards with integrated radio frequency identification (RFID) chips containing
programming used for public transit, payments, loyalty programs, hospitality, transportation, student identification cards,
identification cards, membership cards, parking, event management, vehicle sharing, and access management, namely, access to
certain areas, gaining access to buildings, gaining access to premises, and gaining access to vehicles; computer hardware and
downloadable software for creating, programming, controlling, encoding, scanning, reading and interpreting radio frequency
identification (RFID) chips and tags; encoded integrated circuit cards containing programming used for public transit, payments,
loyalty programs, hospitality, transportation, student identification cards, identification cards, membership cards, parking, event
management, vehicle sharing, and access management, namely, access to certain areas, gaining access to buildings, gaining
access to premises, and gaining access to vehicles; encoded contactless smart cards embedded with transponders, central
processing units, cryptographic co-processors, analog logic, digital logic, and memory for use in public transit, payments, loyalty
programs, hospitality, car access, electric vehicle charging, event management, and access management, namely, access to
certain areas, gaining access to buildings, gaining access to premises, and gaining access to vehicles; blank dual interface smart
cards embedded with transponders, central processing units, cryptographic co-processors, integrated circuits which use analog
logic and digital logic, and memory; encoded dual interface smart cards embedded with transponders, central processing units,
cryptographic co-processors, integrated circuits which use analog logic and digital logic, and memory for use for public transit,
payments, and physical access management, namely, access to certain areas, gaining access to buildings, gaining access to
premises, and gaining access to vehicles; dual interface integrated circuits that provide a link between contactless cards and
contact cards; encoded contactless smart cards containing programming used for determining the fare to be paid by passengers
who book their trip electronically; encoded contactless smart cards containing programming used for gaining access to certain
areas, buildings, premises, and vehicles; RFID writers, namely devices that communicate with radio frequency identification
(RFID) tags and devices that can read and write data onto RFID tags and perform contactless transactions and operations
between the reader and writer devices and smartcards or tag devices for wireless transmission of data to and from transponder
chips; RFID readers for wireless transmission of data to and from transponder chips; RFID readers for wireless transmission of
data to and from transponder chips downloadable computer programs for controlling transmission of data to and reading of data
from transponder chips; electronic card readers combined with electronic data recorders for authenticating identity, controlling
access to social and business events, managing events, ticketing, transit, tourism, hospitality, student cards, loyalty programs,
payment, and access management, namely, access to certain areas, gaining access to buildings, gaining access to premises, and
gaining access to vehicles; electronic wristbands intended to be used for cashless vending, transportation and club membership
identification; computer hardware, downloadable software and computer peripherals used for access control and authentication
purposes; electronic key fobs being remote control apparatus; downloadable cloud computing software for downloading payment
information onto end user devices, namely, mobile phones and wearable devices, sold separately; cloud computing systems
comprised of cloud computing hardware, namely, HSM (high security modules) which are accessed and used by cloud computing
software, namely, hardware security appliance in the nature of a computer hardware security module (HSM) for encrypting
sensitive data; downloadable software for cloud infrastructure for downloading virtual card information and virtual card data onto
end user devices, namely, mobile phones and wearable devices; downloadable cloud computing platform software for use on
mobile devices with near field communication (NFC) functionality to interact with smartcard integrated circuits and connect with
backend cloud software services which provide and manage virtual cards and virtual card data remotely, containing software and
software built by OEMs to emulate smartcard products, interact with smartcard products, and interact with cloud software service
backend systems which provide and manage virtual cards and virtual card data remotely; downloadable cloud computing platform
software for generating smartcard and virtual card encryption key material in a secure HSM module, namely, hardware security
appliance in the nature of a computer hardware security module (HSM) for encrypting sensitive data, deploying virtual machines
to a cloud computing platform, implementing and emulating smartcard functionality in software, personalizing smart cards, and
securely generating data that is used to personalize and download data into smart cards; downloadable computer application
software for providing cloud computing services; downloadable cloud based software solutions for managing digital credentials on
mobile devices and wearable devices, namely, mobile phones and wearable devices supporting NFC-enabled mobile devices for
fare payments made using mobile devices, transit ticketing using mobile devices, and smart card access; computer hardware,
namely, secure access modules; downloadable interface software, namely, mobile device and wearable device interface software
for virtual cards and virtual wallets; secure microprocessors; secure terminals for electronic transactions; downloadable software
for facilitating secure financial transactions; SIM cards; downloadable computer software for the implementation of smartcards on
mobile devices and wearable devices; downloadable software for security and risk management in respect of smartcard
implementation on mobile devices and wearable devices; downloadable host card emulation (HCE) software for storing virtual
smart card on mobile devices and wearable devices, namely, software that enables mobile devices and wearable devices to be
used for making payments, accessing transit and credit and debit transactions at physical point-of-sale (POS) terminals;
downloadable software embedded on a SE (Secure Element), namely, a secure integrated circuit for use in mobile and wearable
device applications which facilitate virtual card storing on mobile devices and wearable devices

research, design and development services related to computer hardware and software for creating, programming, controlling, encoding, scanning, reading and interpreting RFID chips and tags; research, design and development services related to electronic apparatus, instruments and equipment in the nature of NFC reader devices, NFC verification and validation tools, integrated circuit development environments for analog design and digital design, and debugging tools for creating, programming, controlling, encoding, scanning, reading and interpreting RFID chips and tags, antennas for smart card integrated circuits for use with NFC interface; research, design and development services in the field of NFC (near field communications) apparatus, instruments and equipment, namely, electronic, electrotechnical and electromagnetic modules, namely, transistors, analog logic, digital logic, electrotechnical parts and smartcards, parts and building elements, namely, structural parts for the forgoing, and integrated circuits for NFC applications, electronic payment cards, data processing apparatus and computer software for determining the fare to be paid by passengers with electronic travel-tickets; research, design and development services related to structural parts for all the aforesaid goods; custom computer programming for others; custom programming in secure environment of computer hardware used for creating, programming, controlling, encoding, scanning, reading and interpreting RFID chips and tags, electronic apparatus, instruments and equipment for creating, programming, controlling, encoding, scanning, reading and interpreting RFID chips and tags, antennas for smart card integrated circuits for use with NFC interface for scanning, reading and interpreting RFID chips and tags; custom computer programming of NFC (near field communications) apparatus, instruments and equipment, including electronic, electrotechnical and electromagnetic modules, namely, transistors, analog logic, digital logic, electrotechnical parts and smartcards, structural parts for the foregoing and integrated circuits for near field communications applications, electronic payment cards, data processing apparatus and software for determining the fare to be paid by passengers with electronic travel-tickets; custom computer programming of structural parts for all the aforesaid goods; cloud computing, namely, providing virtual computer systems and virtual computer environments through cloud computing and cloud hosting provider services; cloud computing services, namely, providing hosted virtual computer environments through cloud computing; providing temporary use of non-downloadable cloud computing software for use service management for cloud platforms for maintaining service level for cloud service availability and response times; providing temporary use of non-downloadable software for the implementation of virtual cards onto embedded secure integrated circuits for smartcards on mobile devices and wearable devices; providing temporary use of non-downloadable software for security and risk management in respect of smartcard implementation of virtual cards onto embedded secure integrated circuits for on mobile devices and wearable devices; providing temporary use of non-downloadable software for virtual card storing on mobile devices and wearable devices embedded on a HCE (Host Card Emulation), namely, software for securing a mobile phone such that it can be used to make credit or debit transactions at a physical point-of-sale (POS) terminals; providing temporary use of non-downloadable software for virtual smart card storing on mobile devices and wearable device embedded on a SE (Secure Element), namely, a secure integrated circuit; advisory, consultancy and information services in relation to all the aforesaid services
